title: The Survivor's Legacy
journal: The crew didn't scatter. Sazed's translation of the logbook says its author was not the man on the throne, and that the Lord Ruler may be a Feruchemist too. Kelsier left me the eleventh metal and no instructions. In Keep Venture's library I found the pattern: he never takes off his bracers. Elend is staying in Luthadel when his father leaves.

objectives.text: Hear what Sazed found in the logbook

on_complete.text: The hand is cramped and tired. 'He watches me when he thinks I sleep. He believes I am the wrong man for this. Some nights, so do I.'

objectives.text: Look through what Kelsier left behind

on_complete.text: The bead of the eleventh metal, the one he swore was the Lord Ruler's weakness. It's cold, and it isn't like any metal you know. You pocket it.

objectives.text: Ask Dockson what's left of the plan

on_enter.text: Sazed has the logbook. For everything else, there's one noble library in the city you can walk into at night.

objectives.text: Search the histories for the Ascension

on_complete.text: A thousand-year-old account of the Ascension, mostly propaganda. But one plate shows him at the Well, and even then: a band of metal on each forearm.

objectives.text: Check the builders' ledgers from Kredik Shaw

on_complete.text: Venture masons helped raise the palace. Their ledger lists a throne hall with a gallery open to the city — and a prison cut beneath it, 'for those the Lord Ruler wishes to keep.'

objectives.hint_locked: The ink has faded to nothing. Burn tin to make it out.
objectives.text: Find the faded annotations on the gallery

on_complete.text: In an old Venture's scrawl: 'Forty years at court and I never once saw him without the bracers. Not bathing, not sleeping. A man keeps close what keeps him alive.'

objectives.hint_locked: Voices behind the study door, too low to follow. Burn tin.
objectives.text: Listen at the door of Straff Venture's study

on_complete.text: Straff Venture, to his steward: 'The carts leave at the end of the month. My son can stay and play philosopher if he likes. He'll come crawling after us once the fires start.'

objectives.text: Talk to Elend at his desk
